about_the_game:
HerbTea-Man 

is a cozy slice-of-life sim adventure set in 1990s Guangdong, China. You play as Sung, a chubby guy from the north who’s come south to work at an old-fashioned herbal tea shop in the city of Foshan. Your daily tasks? Brewing herbal remedies, gathering ingredients, and dealing with quirky customers — all while navigating the chaotic but charming world of southern street life.

This isn’t just a tea shop — it’s the frontline in a battle against dampness, heat, toxins, and cold! From couples arguing over "too much internal heat" to neighbors losing sleep, your herbal concoctions might just be what the whole community needs.

🎮 Features:

  • 🫖 Original TCM-based system – Diagnose common ailments and brew tea formulas that target the four imbalances: dampness, heat, toxicity, and cold.

  • 🛒 Daily life management – Serve customers, clean the shop, brew the right tea, and handle hilarious local complaints.

  • 🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Neighborhood storytelling – Interact with a colorful cast of locals, each with their own personality and troubles to fix.

  • 🎬 90s Hong Kong flavor – Full of hidden easter eggs and cheeky nods to classic Cantonese films and culture.

  • 🌇 Time-based gameplay – Mornings, afternoons, and nights each offer different activities and encounters.

In a world moving too fast, your little tea shop is a quiet corner where people can slow down, sip something warm (or bitter!), and maybe heal a bit — body and soul.
